data.one_liner: A simple event dispatch mechanism for broadcasting information to registered observers.
data.what_it_does: It provides a centralized notification center using a singleton pattern. It enables broadcasting messages and type-safe payloads across your application with support for subscription management like pause, resume, and cancel.
use_when: You need to decouple components and broadcast events across the app
You want a lightweight pub-sub event bus without heavy state management dependencies
avoid_when: You prefer reactive stream-based solutions like standard Dart Streams or RxDart
You need robust, enterprise-grade state containers or dependency injection frameworks
weaknesses: Relies on a singleton pattern which can make testing more global
Does not handle persistent storage or UI rendering widgets

alternatives.name: eventify
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similar event bus and listener pattern for Dart and Flutter applications.
